WITH race_averages AS (
  SELECT 
    r.name,
    AVG(ds.points) as race_avg
  FROM driverStandings ds
  JOIN races r ON ds.raceId = r.raceId
  WHERE ds.points > 1.0
  GROUP BY r.name
),
overall_avg AS (
  SELECT AVG(race_avg) as overall_avg
  FROM race_averages
)
SELECT 
  ra.name,
  ra.race_avg,
  ra.race_avg - oa.overall_avg as difference
FROM race_averages ra
CROSS JOIN overall_avg oa
WHERE oa.overall_avg IS NOT NULL
  AND ra.race_avg > oa.overall_avg
ORDER BY ra.name
